name: Reset Week at Larkspur Ranch
summary: A luxury week for 8 built around long solo hikes and silent mornings, with a mindfulness coach available. No schedule beyond meals. No experience needed. $4,200.
description:
A week for people who are new to any of this and want to arrive at it through their legs.

**Days**
No programme. Breakfast at 7, dinner at 7. The mornings are silent on the ranch until lunch. Between, guests hike: the ranch has 30 miles of marked trail and access to the national forest, and most guests are out six hours a day. Afternoons are open. Massage, the hot pool, the library.

**Coach**
Elise Tran, a secular mindfulness coach (MBSR-trained), is on the ranch all week. She offers a short optional sit each morning before breakfast and is available for one-on-one conversation any afternoon. Nothing is scheduled with her; guests book time as they wish.

**Level**
Designed for beginners. Elise will teach anyone who asks, from zero. The hiking is hard, though: long climbs, altitude, weather.

**Accommodation**
Private cabins, full board, chef.
practical: Sunday to Sunday, June to September. $4,200 including private cabin, all meals, and coaching. 8 guests. Bring broken-in hiking boots, layers, sun protection, a day pack. Nearest airport Bozeman; ranch transfer included. Wifi in the lodge, none in the cabins.
